name: blur-fade
blurb: Elements fade and unblur as they enter the viewport.
description: Wraps children in a blur/opacity fade animation triggered on viewport intersection. Customizable direction, duration, blur amount, and trigger.
use_when: Scroll-triggered reveals, progressive content loading, or entrance animations.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (no prefers-reduced-motion support); fast-scrolling content.
a11y: Animation wrapper; motion-based only. Does not affect content accessibility.
